title: Tiger Shroff Registers for Durand Cup With His Club Mumbay FC
excerpt: The Bollywood action star has been officially registered for Asia's oldest football tournament and is expected to feature in the club's final group-stage match in Shillong.
body:
• Tiger Shroff has been registered as a player in Mumbai FC's squad for the 135th Durand Cup, sources confirmed to RevSportz
  • The Bollywood actor is expected to appear in the club's final group-stage fixture, with the team travelling to Shillong on July 30
  • Mumbay FC, founded by Shroff in July 2024, is making its debut in Asia's oldest football tournament after finishing third in I-League 3
  • Shroff previously made his professional football debut in the Mumbai Premier League in October 2023, wearing the No. 7 jersey

Tiger Shroff has been registered as part of Mumbay FC's squad for the 135th Durand Cup, making the Bollywood action star eligible to play in one of India's most prestigious football competitions. Sources close to the club confirmed that Shroff has been training regularly with the team and is likely to feature in their final group-stage match.

"Tiger has registered with the team and is most likely to make an appearance in the final group-stage match. He has been training regularly with the squad."

— Source close to the club, speaking to RevSportz

From Speculation to Registration

The confirmation ends weeks of speculation about whether Shroff would actually take the field in the Durand Cup. Earlier reports from RevSportz in early July indicated the club was "hopeful" of fielding him, but a final decision hinged on completing the player registration process. That process is now complete, with Shroff's name included in Mumbay FC's official squad list.

https://www.instagram.com/p/DaLMNL4soOY/

Mumbay FC will travel to Shillong on July 30 for their group-stage fixtures. Drawn in Group E, the club faces Shillong Lajong FC, Nongkseh Sports & Cultural Club, and Langsning FC, with all matches at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Shillong.

Mumbay FC's Rapid Rise

Shroff launched Mumbay FC in July 2024 with the stated goal of building Mumbai's football ecosystem. The club, which competes in the Mumbai Football Association's top division, brought in experienced Indian footballers to mentor a young squad — and the results came quickly.

https://x.com/RevSportzGlobal/status/2081644279064359133

Mumbay FC won the inaugural Maharashtra State Club League Championship before finishing third in the I-League 3 last season. That performance earned the club a spot in this year's Durand Cup, marking their first appearance in Asia's oldest football tournament, now in its 135th edition.

Shroff's Football Journey

Shroff made his professional football debut in the Mumbai Premier League in October 2024, signing for his own club as its marquee player. Wearing the No. 7 jersey — a nod to his admiration for Cristiano Ronaldo — his appearance generated widespread attention, with clips of him in action going viral on social media.

Mumbay FC head coach Zoheb Khan has consistently praised Shroff's abilities. "I noticed that Tiger has a special gift for football. He stands out even when playing with other professionals, such as ISL and I-League players," Khan told RevSportz in an earlier interview. "He started training more seriously, not just on weekends, but also on weekdays. I saw his potential as a professional and suggested he try playing professionally."

"I always wanted to be a footballer. Football was a big part of my life in school. Representing my country was a dream I never got to fulfil."

— Tiger Shroff, after his professional debut in 2024

Bollywood and Indian Football

Shroff's registration fits a broader pattern of Bollywood's deepening involvement in Indian football. John Abraham's NorthEast United FC won the last two editions of the Durand Cup. Abhishek Bachchan co-owns Chennaiyin FC in the Indian Super League. Shroff himself has spoken about playing casual matches with fellow actors Kartik Aaryan, Shoojit Sircar, and Bachchan.

But Shroff's involvement goes a step further than ownership or celebrity cameos. If he takes the field against Langsning FC or another Group E opponent, he would be among the rare Bollywood figures to compete as a registered player in a top-tier Indian football tournament.

What to Watch

Mumbay FC's first match is against Langsning FC on August 3 at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Shillong. The team's final group-stage fixture — where Shroff is most likely to appear — has yet to be confirmed on the official schedule. With the squad departing for Shillong on July 30, the coming days will determine whether India's most famous action star makes his Durand Cup bow.
